book.name: Matayo
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Matayo

content: Kuhyoka kwa Yesu
18 Palapetiki Lichobha la Sabato, lukela pachiwombu lichobha lela la Jumapile, Malia Magidalena, na Malia jongi jola bhakapiti kulibhona litengeli.
Palapala pakapitali chinyukunyuku chikolongwa cha ndema, kwa ndandi mtumika wa kunani waka Bambo akahelile kuhuma kunani kumahunde, akalihingali liganga la pundyangu lela, na kulitamila panani.
Sula jaki jakabhi ngati unang'anu wa chitobhi, na ingobhu yaki ihuhu kupukupu.
Bhalonda bha litengeli bhala pabhakumbweni bhakabhaghiji kwa choghohi, na kubha ngati bhabhapotile.
Mtumika wa kunani kwaka Chapanga jola akabhapwaghi akambomba bhala, “Mwehapa ngamwijogopa! Kwa ndandi manyi kubha mundonda Yesu, joakawambakike punsalaba.
Ngacheabhi pambane, kwa ndandi ahyokike ngati moakapwaghile. Muhikaje pambani mupabhona pandu pabhakungoniki Bambo.
Bhela njendanya manyata, mkabhapwaghila bhabhulwa bhaki, ‘Ahyokiki kuhuma kwa bhakuwa. Lingalyaje, sajenu andongulela kujenda ku Galilaya, konihoku nde komwakumbonaje.’ Haya, nyomwi kumpwaghila.”
Bhakabhokiki manyata kuhuma palitengeli, kwa choghohi na chiheku chamaheli, na kubhutuka imbelu kubhapwaghila bhabhulwa bhaki.
Palapala Yesu akahimangini nabhu, akapwaghaje, “Lukwali lubya na mwehapa!” Akambomba bhala bhakunheghalili, bhakachikimi na kunkamula magholu, na kunjojabhela.
Panihapa Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Ngamwijoghopa, njendanya mkabhapwaghila bhalongu bhangu bhajenda ku Galilaya, konihoku nde kobhakamonaje.”
Ubholu wa bhalonda bha litengeli
Akambomba bhala pabhakabhi bhajenda, lingalyaje, bhalonda bha litengeli bhakumu bhakajingi mumbwane, na kubhapwaghi bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa mambu ghokapi ghaghahengakike.
Bhela, bhakalibhongini papamu na bhazee, na pabhakalongalanile, bhakabhapeki manjolinjoli bhala mbija yamaheli,
bhakapwaghaje, “Mabhanganya mpwagha kubha, ‘Bhabhulwa bhaki bhakahikiki ikilu, na kunjibha chikahi tepani patwaghochile.’
Ngati nkolongwa anaajowini malobhi ghangane, tepani anatulongila naku, na mwehapa ngamwipati mang'ahiku ghokapi ghala.”
Bhela bhakaitoliki mbija hyela, na kuhenga ngati mobhabholakike. Lilobhi leniheli lakajaghani pachilanda ja Bhayahude mbaka lalenu.
Yesu abhapitali bhabhulwa bhaki
Bhabhulwa komi na jumu bhala bhakapiti ku Galilaya, mbaka ku chitombi chela cheakabhalaghalaki Yesu.
Pabhakumbweni bhakunjojabhile. Nambu bhakumu bhabhu bhakabhili na choghoi.
Yesu akabhaheghalili na kubhapwaghila, “Mbekiwi lujiniku lwokapi kunani kumahunde na pundema.
Bhela, njendanya mkabhabhola bhandu bha pundema wokapi bhakubha bhabhulwa bhangu, koni mkabhabatizaje kwa lihina la Atati, na laka Mwana, na laka Roho Mhuhu.
Mubhabhola kukamula mambu ghokapi ghanundaghalaki mwehapa. Na lingalyaje, nepani mili papamu na mwehapa machobha ghokapi, mbaka ujomukelu wa chikahi.”
